panel.title: USB Manager
panel.empty-hint: Plug in a USB drive or external disk to manage it here

settings.hide-when-empty-desc: Hide the taskbar icon when no USB drives are connected.
settings.show-badge-desc: Show the number of mounted drives on the taskbar icon.
settings.icon-color-desc: Custom icon tint. Choose None for the default color.
settings.auto-mount-desc: Mount USB partitions automatically when plugged in.
settings.notifications-desc: Show a toast when drives are mounted, unmounted, or ejected.
settings.file-browser-desc: Command used to open mounted drives (e.g. xdg-open, dolphin, thunar, nautilus, yazi).
settings.terminal-desc: Terminal used when the file manager runs in a terminal (yazi, ranger, etc.).
